## New

- **11 UI languages**: English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Deutsch, Français, Español, Português, Italiano, Русский — auto-detected from your Obsidian language, switchable in Settings → General
- README now available in all 11 languages

No changes to the agent, search, indexing or MCP behavior.
